source_row.rationale: Neurovascular checks are important because a cast can potentially compress underlying tissue and blood vessels as swelling occurs after injury or surgery, so regular assessment helps detect early compromise (a precursor to compartment syndrome) before permanent tissue damage occurs, requiring ongoing monitoring, not just a single initial check.
